map.最大摄氧量是单位体重每分钟消耗氧气峰值（ml/kg/min），是心肺耐力金标准。: VO₂max is the peak oxygen consumption per unit body weight per minute (ml/kg/min)—the gold standard of cardiorespiratory endurance. Ordinary people are about 35–45; endurance athletes can reach 60–70+. It is shaped by both genetics and training; regular aerobic training for 8–12 weeks can raise it 10–20%.
map.距离法和体重的关系？: What is the relation between the distance method and body weight?
map.Cooper 距离公式输出的是相对值（ml/kg/min），已含体重口径；绝对摄: The Cooper distance formula outputs a relative value (ml/kg/min) already normalized by weight; multiply by weight for absolute VO₂ in L/min, reflecting total aerobic capacity. Those with high body weight may show a lower relative value but not necessarily a lower absolute value; relative value usually rises after fat loss.
